q: 他的书桌上___的，找不到作业本。
zh: 他的书桌上乱七八糟的，找不到作业本。
py: tā de shū zhuō shàng luàn qī bā zāo de zhǎo bù dào zuò yè běn
en: His desk is a total mess; he cannot find his exercise book.
why: A desk where nothing can be found is 乱七八糟, a total mess. 十全十美 (perfect) is the opposite, and 一模一样 (exactly alike) says nothing about order.

q: 小王做作业总是___，错字很多。
zh: 小王做作业总是马马虎虎，错字很多。
py: xiǎo wáng zuò zuò yè zǒng shì mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ cuò zì hěn duō
en: Xiao Wang always does his homework carelessly; there are many wrong characters.
why: Many wrong characters show careless work: 马马虎虎. 一丝不苟 means meticulous, so it contradicts the clause about mistakes.

q: 我总是___，今天出门又忘了带手机。
zh: 我总是丢三落四，今天出门又忘了带手机。
py: wǒ zǒng shì diū sān là sì jīn tiān chū mén yòu wàng le dài shǒu jī
en: I am always forgetting things; today I left the house without my phone again.
why: Always forgetting things is 丢三落四 (read là, not luò). 半途而废 is about giving up halfway, and the other two do not describe a person who forgets.

q: 手机快没电了，他___地到处找充电器。
zh: 手机快没电了，他手忙脚乱地到处找充电器。
py: shǒu jī kuài méi diàn le tā shǒu máng jiǎo luàn de dào chù zhǎo chōng diàn qì
en: His phone was about to die, so he hunted for the charger in a flustered rush.
why: A hurried, flustered search is 手忙脚乱. 津津有味 (with relish) and 兴高采烈 (cheerful) do not fit a battery running out, and 一丝不苟 (meticulous) is the opposite of a panic.

q: 这件事是小李做的，你___了，别怪小王。
zh: 这件事是小李做的，你张冠李戴了，别怪小王。
py: zhè jiàn shì shì xiǎo lǐ zuò de nǐ zhāng guān lǐ dài le bié guài xiǎo wáng
en: Xiao Li did this; you have mixed people up, so do not blame Xiao Wang.
why: Pinning something on the wrong person is 张冠李戴 (one man's hat on another). The others are about talking to oneself, spoiling things, or wasted effort.

q: 你一边看手机一边写作业，这样___，两件事都做不好。
zh: 你一边看手机一边写作业，这样三心二意，两件事都做不好。
py: nǐ yī biān kàn shǒu jī yī biān xiě zuò yè zhè yàng sān xīn èr yì liǎng jiàn shì dōu zuò bù hǎo
en: If you check your phone while doing homework like that, you are half-hearted and will do neither well.
why: Splitting your attention between two things is 三心二意. The other three all describe full concentration, which is exactly what the sentence says is missing.

q: 考试只剩五分钟了，她还有三道题没写，急得___。
zh: 考试只剩五分钟了，她还有三道题没写，急得手忙脚乱。
py: kǎo shì zhǐ shèng wǔ fēn zhōng le tā hái yǒu sān dào tí méi xiě jí de shǒu máng jiǎo luàn
en: There were only five minutes left in the exam and she still had three questions to do; she was in a flustered rush.
why: Time pressure that makes someone rush and fumble is 手忙脚乱. 兴高采烈 and 津津有味 are happy states, and 理所当然 cannot follow 急得.

q: 我的衣柜里___，找不到那件蓝裙子。
zh: 我的衣柜里乱七八糟，找不到那件蓝裙子。
py: wǒ de yī guì lǐ luàn qī bā zāo zhǎo bù dào nà jiàn lán qún zi
en: My wardrobe is a total mess; I cannot find that blue skirt.
why: A wardrobe where you cannot find things is 乱七八糟. 万事如意 and 一路平安 are wishes, and 十全十美 means perfect.

q: 你游泳游得怎么样？我游得___，还要多练习。
zh: 你游泳游得怎么样？我游得马马虎虎，还要多练习。
py: nǐ yóu yǒng yóu de zěn me yàng wǒ yóu de mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ hái yào duō liàn xí
en: How is your swimming? So-so; I still need to practise more.
why: Answering "how is it?" modestly, "so-so", is 马马虎虎. The other idioms describe effort or care, not a modest rating, and "still need practice" fits a so-so level.

s: 我总是张冠李戴，出门忘带钥匙。
s_py: wǒ zǒng shì zhāng guān lǐ dài chū mén wàng dài yào shi
zh: 我总是丢三落四，出门忘带钥匙。
py: wǒ zǒng shì diū sān là sì chū mén wàng dài yào shi
en: I am always forgetting things; I forget my keys when I go out.
why: 张冠李戴 means mixing up who did or said what, not forgetting things. Always forgetting belongings is 丢三落四.

s: 弟弟写作业马马虎虎，老师让他重做。
s_py: dì di xiě zuò yè mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ lǎo shī ràng tā chóng zuò
zh: 弟弟写作业马马虎虎，老师让他重做。
py: dì di xiě zuò yè mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ lǎo shī ràng tā chóng zuò
en: My little brother did his homework carelessly, so the teacher made him redo it.
why: Correct. About someone's work, 马马虎虎 means careless, and being made to redo it fits that meaning.

q: 同学们___地听老师讲课。
zh: 同学们聚精会神地听老师讲课。
py: tóng xué men jù jīng huì shén de tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè
en: The students listened to the teacher with full attention.
why: Listening with total concentration is 聚精会神 + 地 before the verb. 半途而废 is giving up, and 莫名其妙 or 七上八下 are not ways of listening.

q: 明天是篮球决赛，我们一定要___。
zh: 明天是篮球决赛，我们一定要全力以赴。
py: míng tiān shì lán qiú jué sài wǒ men yī dìng yào quán lì yǐ fù
en: Tomorrow is the basketball final; we must give it everything.
why: For an important final you give everything: 全力以赴. 半途而废 (quit halfway), 画蛇添足 (spoil by adding) and 马马虎虎 (careless) are all the wrong attitude.

q: 他学了一年钢琴就不学了，真是___。
zh: 他学了一年钢琴就不学了，真是半途而废。
py: tā xué le yī nián gāng qín jiù bù xué le zhēn shì bàn tú ér fèi
en: He gave up the piano after one year; he really did quit halfway.
why: Starting something and stopping before it is finished is 半途而废. The other three describe working hard, which does not match quitting.

q: 他备考的时候___，常常一天只吃一顿饭。
zh: 他备考的时候废寝忘食，常常一天只吃一顿饭。
py: tā bèi kǎo de shí hou fèi qǐn wàng shí cháng cháng yī tiān zhǐ chī yī dùn fàn
en: When he was preparing for the exam he was so absorbed he forgot to eat and sleep, often eating only one meal a day.
why: Skipping meals because of work is the definition of 废寝忘食. 兴高采烈 is cheerful and 理所当然 means only natural; neither explains eating once a day.

q: 电脑坏了，修理店的人说没救了，他还是___地想把里面的照片救回来。
zh: 电脑坏了，修理店的人说没救了，他还是千方百计地想把里面的照片救回来。
py: diàn nǎo huài le xiū lǐ diàn de rén shuō méi jiù le tā hái shi qiān fāng bǎi jì de xiǎng bǎ lǐ miàn de zhào piàn jiù huí lái
en: His computer was broken and the repair shop said it was hopeless, but he still tried every way to save the photos on it.
why: Trying every possible means despite bad news is 千方百计 + 地. 半途而废 would mean he gave up, which 还是 contradicts.

q: 她做事一向___，连作业本上的标点都要检查三遍。
zh: 她做事一向一丝不苟，连作业本上的标点都要检查三遍。
py: tā zuò shì yī xiàng yī sī bù gǒu lián zuò yè běn shàng de biāo diǎn dōu yào jiǎn chá sān biàn
en: She has always been meticulous; she even checks the punctuation in her exercise book three times.
why: Checking even punctuation three times is meticulous to the last detail: 一丝不苟. The other three are careless or distracted, so 连...都 makes no sense with them.

q: 写调查报告要___，不能为了好看改数字。
zh: 写调查报告要实事求是，不能为了好看改数字。
py: xiě diào chá bào gào yào shí shì qiú shì bù néng wèi le hǎo kàn gǎi shù zì
en: A survey report has to stick to the facts; you cannot change the numbers to make it look better.
why: Not altering numbers means sticking to the facts: 实事求是. 一见钟情 is about love, 画蛇添足 is about adding something unneeded, and 小心翼翼 describes how you move.

q: 考试时他___地做题，连旁边有人咳嗽也没听见。
zh: 考试时他聚精会神地做题，连旁边有人咳嗽也没听见。
py: kǎo shì shí tā jù jīng huì shén de zuò tí lián páng biān yǒu rén ké sou yě méi tīng jiàn
en: During the exam he was so absorbed in the questions that he did not even hear someone coughing next to him.
why: Not hearing a cough means total concentration: 聚精会神. 手忙脚乱 would mean panic, which does not explain missing the noise, and 讨价还价 is haggling.

q: 比赛只剩最后五分钟了，我们必须___，不能放弃。
zh: 比赛只剩最后五分钟了，我们必须全力以赴，不能放弃。
py: bǐ sài zhǐ shèng zuì hòu wǔ fēn zhōng le wǒ men bì xū quán lì yǐ fù bù néng fàng qì
en: Only five minutes of the match remain; we must give it everything and not give up.
why: "Must not give up" goes with giving everything: 全力以赴. The other idioms are about love, contradiction or variety and do not fit the pep talk.

s: 他全力以赴这次考试。
s_py: tā quán lì yǐ fù zhè cì kǎo shì
zh: 他为这次考试全力以赴。
py: tā wèi zhè cì kǎo shì quán lì yǐ fù
en: He gave it everything for this exam.
why: 全力以赴 does not take a direct object. The task is introduced with 为 (or put first) and the idiom comes last.

s: 他废寝忘食地写代码，连午饭都忘了吃。
s_py: tā fèi qǐn wàng shí de xiě dài mǎ lián wǔ fàn dōu wàng le chī
zh: 他废寝忘食地写代码，连午饭都忘了吃。
py: tā fèi qǐn wàng shí de xiě dài mǎ lián wǔ fàn dōu wàng le chī
en: He wrote code so intensely he forgot to eat and sleep; he even forgot lunch.
why: Correct. 废寝忘食 works as an adverbial with 地 before the verb, and forgetting lunch matches its meaning.

q: 做数学题要___，不能一边玩一边做。
zh: 做数学题要聚精会神，不能一边玩一边做。
py: zuò shù xué tí yào jù jīng huì shén bù néng yī biān wán yī biān zuò
en: You have to concentrate on maths problems; you cannot play while doing them.
why: "Cannot play while doing them" asks for full concentration: 聚精会神. The other options say nothing about attention.

q: 为了买到那双限量版球鞋，他___地想了很多办法。
zh: 为了买到那双限量版球鞋，他千方百计地想了很多办法。
py: wèi le mǎi dào nà shuāng xiàn liàng bǎn qiú xié tā qiān fāng bǎi jì de xiǎng le hěn duō bàn fǎ
en: To get that limited-edition pair of trainers he thought of every possible way.
why: Trying every possible means is 千方百计. 一见钟情 and 自相矛盾 cannot modify a verb like this, and 各种各样 needs 的 before a noun.

q: 放假了，孩子们___地去公园玩。
zh: 放假了，孩子们兴高采烈地去公园玩。
py: fàng jià le hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de qù gōng yuán wán
en: The holiday began and the children went off to the park in high spirits.
why: A holiday makes children cheerful: 兴高采烈. 七上八下 is anxiety and 莫名其妙 means baffling.

q: 他一边看球赛一边吃西瓜，吃得___。
zh: 他一边看球赛一边吃西瓜，吃得津津有味。
py: tā yī biān kàn qiú sài yī biān chī xī guā chī de jīn jīn yǒu wèi
en: He ate watermelon while watching the match, and ate with relish.
why: Eating with obvious enjoyment is 吃得津津有味. 七上八下 is anxious and 半途而废 is quitting, neither describes enjoying food.

q: 新手机刚到，弟弟连饭都顾不上吃，___地拆开了盒子。
zh: 新手机刚到，弟弟连饭都顾不上吃，迫不及待地拆开了盒子。
py: xīn shǒu jī gāng dào dì di lián fàn dōu gù bù shàng chī pò bù jí dài de chāi kāi le hé zi
en: The new phone had just arrived and my little brother, not even stopping for dinner, could not wait to tear open the box.
why: Too eager to even eat is 迫不及待 (unable to wait). The other options do not describe eagerness.

q: 那只猫很胆小，我___地把它从树上抱了下来。
zh: 那只猫很胆小，我小心翼翼地把它从树上抱了下来。
py: nà zhī māo hěn dǎn xiǎo wǒ xiǎo xīn yì yì de bǎ tā cóng shù shàng bào le xià lái
en: The cat was very timid, so I lifted it down from the tree very carefully.
why: Handling a timid animal gently is 小心翼翼 + 地. 兴高采烈 (cheerful) is a mood, not a way of handling, and the others do not fit.

q: 明天就要公布考试成绩了，我心里___的，晚上睡不着。
zh: 明天就要公布考试成绩了，我心里七上八下的，晚上睡不着。
py: míng tiān jiù yào gōng bù kǎo shì chéng jì le wǒ xīn li qī shàng bā xià de wǎn shang shuì bù zháo
en: Tomorrow the exam results come out; I am on edge and cannot sleep tonight.
why: Anxiety before results, with 心里, is 七上八下. 兴高采烈 would mean cheerful, which does not explain not sleeping.

q: 听了老师的解释，我___，原来这个字是这样用的。
zh: 听了老师的解释，我恍然大悟，原来这个字是这样用的。
py: tīng le lǎo shī de jiě shì wǒ huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái zhè ge zì shì zhè yàng yòng de
en: After the teacher's explanation it suddenly clicked: so that is how this character is used.
why: An explanation leading to sudden understanding, followed by 原来, is 恍然大悟. The other options do not describe understanding.

q: 他对这只小狗___，当天就把它带回了家。
zh: 他对这只小狗一见钟情，当天就把它带回了家。
py: tā duì zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu yī jiàn zhōng qíng dāng tiān jiù bǎ tā dài huí le jiā
en: He fell for this puppy at first sight and took it home the same day.
why: Instant attachment with 对 + target is 一见钟情. 迫不及待 and 理所当然 do not fit after 对 + a thing, and 莫名其妙 would mean unreasonable.

q: 奶奶戴着老花镜，看手机里的短视频看得___。
zh: 奶奶戴着老花镜，看手机里的短视频看得津津有味。
py: nǎi nai dài zhe lǎo huā jìng kàn shǒu jī lǐ de duǎn shì pín kàn de jīn jīn yǒu wèi
en: Grandma, wearing her reading glasses, watched the short videos on the phone with great relish.
why: After 看得, absorbed enjoyment is 津津有味. 七上八下 is anxiety, 半途而废 is quitting, and 万事如意 is a wish, not a way of watching.

q: 球队赢了比赛，球迷们___地唱起歌来。
zh: 球队赢了比赛，球迷们兴高采烈地唱起歌来。
py: qiú duì yíng le bǐ sài qiú mí men xìng gāo cǎi liè de chàng qǐ gē lái
en: The team won, and the fans burst into song in high spirits.
why: Winning makes fans cheerful, so 兴高采烈地唱起歌来. 七上八下 and 小心翼翼 do not fit singing, and 聚精会神 is about concentration.

q: 朋友说点屏幕上那个小图标就行，我这才___。
zh: 朋友说点屏幕上那个小图标就行，我这才恍然大悟。
py: péng you shuō diǎn píng mù shàng nà ge xiǎo tú biāo jiù xíng wǒ zhè cái huǎng rán dà wù
en: My friend said to tap that little icon on the screen, and only then did I suddenly get it.
why: 这才 marks the moment of understanding after a hint: 恍然大悟. 莫名其妙 would mean it still made no sense.

q: 妈妈给我买了新裙子，我___地穿上它去上学。
zh: 妈妈给我买了新裙子，我兴高采烈地穿上它去上学。
py: mā ma gěi wǒ mǎi le xīn qún zi wǒ xìng gāo cǎi liè de chuān shàng tā qù shàng xué
en: Mum bought me a new skirt and I happily put it on and went to school.
why: A new skirt makes a child cheerful: 兴高采烈. 七上八下 is anxiety and 半途而废 is quitting.

q: 听说新的网络游戏今天上线，他___地打开了电脑。
zh: 听说新的网络游戏今天上线，他迫不及待地打开了电脑。
py: tīng shuō xīn de wǎng luò yóu xì jīn tiān shàng xiàn tā pò bù jí dài de dǎ kāi le diàn nǎo
en: He heard the new online game was launching today and could not wait to switch on his computer.
why: Eagerness for a launch is 迫不及待. 小心翼翼 and 一丝不苟 are about care and do not suit switching on a computer, and 莫名其妙 means baffling.

s: 成绩快出来了，我心里兴高采烈的。
s_py: chéng jì kuài chū lái le wǒ xīn li xìng gāo cǎi liè de
zh: 成绩快出来了，我心里七上八下的。
py: chéng jì kuài chū lái le wǒ xīn li qī shàng bā xià de
en: The results are about to come out and I am on edge.
why: 兴高采烈 describes outward joy and does not go with 心里 while waiting. Nervous waiting is 心里七上八下.

s: 他对这条裙子一见钟情，马上买了下来。
s_py: tā duì zhè tiáo qún zi yī jiàn zhōng qíng mǎ shàng mǎi le xià lái
zh: 他对这条裙子一见钟情，马上买了下来。
py: tā duì zhè tiáo qún zi yī jiàn zhōng qíng mǎ shàng mǎi le xià lái
en: He fell for this dress at first sight and bought it straight away.
why: Correct. 一见钟情 can be used for things as well as people, with 对 introducing what is loved.

s: 弟弟很兴高采烈地玩游戏。
s_py: dì di hěn xìng gāo cǎi liè de wán yóu xì
zh: 弟弟兴高采烈地玩游戏。
py: dì di xìng gāo cǎi liè de wán yóu xì
en: My little brother plays the game in high spirits.
why: 兴高采烈 already means very cheerful, so 很 cannot be put in front. Use it bare.

q: 我的手机明明放在包里，现在却不见了，真___。
zh: 我的手机明明放在包里，现在却不见了，真莫名其妙。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī míng míng fàng zài bāo lǐ xiàn zài què bù jiàn le zhēn mò míng qí miào
en: My phone was clearly in my bag and now it has vanished; it makes no sense.
why: Something that happens for no understandable reason is 莫名其妙. 理所当然 means only natural, which is the opposite of a surprise.

q: 三岁的孩子会用平板电脑写字，真___。
zh: 三岁的孩子会用平板电脑写字，真不可思议。
py: sān suì de hái zi huì yòng píng bǎn diàn nǎo xiě zì zhēn bù kě sī yì
en: A three-year-old who can write on a tablet is amazing.
why: Astonishment at something hard to believe is 不可思议. 无所谓 means indifferent, which is not how one reacts to this.

q: 你想吃火锅还是烧烤？我___，你决定吧。
zh: 你想吃火锅还是烧烤？我无所谓，你决定吧。
py: nǐ xiǎng chī huǒ guō hái shi shāo kǎo wǒ wú suǒ wèi nǐ jué dìng ba
en: Do you want hotpot or barbecue? I don't mind; you decide.
why: Handing the choice over means "I don't mind": 无所谓. 迫不及待 would insist on one choice.

q: 学生按时交作业是___的事。
zh: 学生按时交作业是理所当然的事。
py: xué sheng àn shí jiāo zuò yè shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de shì
en: Students handing in their homework on time is only natural.
why: Something that goes without saying is 理所当然 + 的 before 事. 莫名其妙 and 不可思议 call it baffling or amazing, and 十全十美 (perfect) says nothing about duty.

q: 这件外套太好看了，我___都要买。
zh: 这件外套太好看了，我无论如何都要买。
py: zhè jiàn wài tào tài hǎo kàn le wǒ wú lùn rú hé dōu yào mǎi
en: This jacket is so nice; I will buy it no matter what.
why: 无论如何 + 都 means "no matter what". The other options cannot go before 都要买 with that meaning.

q: 买衣服时别太挑剔，世界上没有___的东西。
zh: 买衣服时别太挑剔，世界上没有十全十美的东西。
py: mǎi yī fu shí bié tài tiāo tī shì jiè shàng méi yǒu shí quán shí měi de dōng xi
en: Do not be too picky when buying clothes; nothing in the world is perfect.
why: "Too picky" goes with "nothing is perfect": 十全十美. 九牛一毛 is a tiny amount, and the other two do not describe a thing.

q: 他一个月赚好几万，这两百块钱对他来说只是___。
zh: 他一个月赚好几万，这两百块钱对他来说只是九牛一毛。
py: tā yī gè yuè zhuàn hǎo jǐ wàn zhè liǎng bǎi kuài qián duì tā lái shuō zhǐ shì jiǔ niú yī máo
en: He earns tens of thousands a month; two hundred yuan is a drop in the ocean to him.
why: A tiny sum next to a large income is 九牛一毛. 十全十美 means perfect and 一举两得 means two gains from one action.

q: 我的网课老师讲得很快，我听得___，一点也不明白。
zh: 我的网课老师讲得很快，我听得莫名其妙，一点也不明白。
py: wǒ de wǎng kè lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn kuài wǒ tīng de mò míng qí miào yī diǎn yě bù míng bai
en: My online teacher speaks fast; I listen completely baffled and understand nothing.
why: "Understand nothing" means baffled: 听得莫名其妙. 津津有味 and 兴高采烈 are enjoyment, and 恍然大悟 is sudden understanding.

q: 不管下雨还是晴天，他都___，反正每天都去跑步。
zh: 不管下雨还是晴天，他都无所谓，反正每天都去跑步。
py: bù guǎn xià yǔ hái shi qíng tiān tā dōu wú suǒ wèi fǎn zhèng měi tiān dōu qù pǎo bù
en: Rain or shine he doesn't mind; he goes running every day anyway.
why: Rain or shine makes no difference to him: 无所谓. 七上八下 is anxiety, and 不可思议 would call the weather astonishing.

q: 我借了朋友的书，按时还给他是___的。
zh: 我借了朋友的书，按时还给他是理所当然的。
py: wǒ jiè le péng you de shū àn shí huán gěi tā shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de
en: I borrowed a friend's book; giving it back on time is only natural.
why: Returning a borrowed book on time goes without saying: 理所当然 + 的. 莫名其妙 and 不可思议 would call it baffling or incredible.

q: 这只鹦鹉竟然能背出整首诗，太___了。
zh: 这只鹦鹉竟然能背出整首诗，太不可思议了。
py: zhè zhī yīng wǔ jìng rán néng bèi chū zhěng shǒu shī tài bù kě sī yì le
en: This parrot can actually recite a whole poem; it is incredible.
why: 竟然 signals surprise, and 太...了 with 不可思议 expresses amazement. 理所当然 would say it is only natural, contradicting 竟然.

q: 红的蓝的我都___，你帮我选一件就行。
zh: 红的蓝的我都无所谓，你帮我选一件就行。
py: hóng de lán de wǒ dōu wú suǒ wèi nǐ bāng wǒ xuǎn yī jiàn jiù xíng
en: I don't mind red or blue; just pick one for me.
why: Not caring which colour is 无所谓. The other options are wishes or descriptions of mess and perfection.

s: 同桌没有原因就不理我了，真是理所当然。
s_py: tóng zhuō méi yǒu yuán yīn jiù bù lǐ wǒ le zhēn shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán
zh: 同桌没有原因就不理我了，真是莫名其妙。
py: tóng zhuō méi yǒu yuán yīn jiù bù lǐ wǒ le zhēn shì mò míng qí miào
en: My desk mate stopped talking to me for no reason; it makes no sense.
why: Doing something with no reason is 莫名其妙. 理所当然 means only natural, which contradicts 没有原因.

s: 这么小的手机竟能放下一千首歌，真不可思议。
s_py: zhè me xiǎo de shǒu jī jìng néng fàng xià yī qiān shǒu gē zhēn bù kě sī yì
zh: 这么小的手机竟能放下一千首歌，真不可思议。
py: zhè me xiǎo de shǒu jī jìng néng fàng xià yī qiān shǒu gē zhēn bù kě sī yì
en: A phone this small can hold a thousand songs; it is incredible.
why: Correct. 不可思议 can take 真 and expresses admiring amazement, which fits 竟能.

q: 这篇作文已经写得很完整了，再加一段就是___。
zh: 这篇作文已经写得很完整了，再加一段就是画蛇添足。
py: zhè piān zuò wén yǐ jīng xiě de hěn wán zhěng le zài jiā yī duàn jiù shì huà shé tiān zú
en: This essay is already complete; adding another paragraph would only spoil it.
why: Adding something unneeded to something already finished is 画蛇添足. The other story idioms are about audience, waiting for luck, or repairing a loss.

q: 你跟没学过篮球的人讲战术，真是___。
zh: 你跟没学过篮球的人讲战术，真是对牛弹琴。
py: nǐ gēn méi xué guò lán qiú de rén jiǎng zhàn shù zhēn shì duì niú tán qín
en: Explaining tactics to someone who has never played basketball is like playing the lute to a cow.
why: Talking to someone who cannot understand is 对牛弹琴. 画蛇添足 is adding something unneeded, which is not the issue here.

q: 想考好就得每天复习，不能___，等着好运气自己来。
zh: 想考好就得每天复习，不能守株待兔，等着好运气自己来。
py: xiǎng kǎo hǎo jiù děi měi tiān fù xí bù néng shǒu zhū dài tù děng zhe hǎo yùn qi zì jǐ lái
en: To do well you have to review every day; you cannot sit and wait for good luck to come.
why: Waiting passively for luck is 守株待兔. 废寝忘食 is working too hard, the opposite, and 亡羊补牢 is about repairing a loss.

q: 手机被偷以后，他才给手机设了密码，不过这也算___。
zh: 手机被偷以后，他才给手机设了密码，不过这也算亡羊补牢。
py: shǒu jī bèi tōu yǐ hòu tā cái gěi shǒu jī shè le mì mǎ bù guò zhè yě suàn wáng yáng bǔ láo
en: Only after his phone was stolen did he set a password, but at least that is better late than never.
why: Fixing a problem after a loss is 亡羊补牢, and it is encouraging, not a criticism. 守株待兔 is passive waiting and 画蛇添足 is spoiling by adding.

q: 整天只玩手机，不出去看看世界，你会变成___。
zh: 整天只玩手机，不出去看看世界，你会变成井底之蛙。
py: zhěng tiān zhǐ wán shǒu jī bù chū qù kàn kan shì jiè nǐ huì biàn chéng jǐng dǐ zhī wā
en: If you only play on your phone all day and never go out to see the world, you will become a frog in a well.
why: 变成 needs a noun, and 井底之蛙 is a noun for someone with a narrow view. 九牛一毛 and 各种各样 are not nouns for a person, and 一路平安 is a wish.

q: 他一会儿说喜欢小狗，一会儿又说讨厌小狗，说话太___了。
zh: 他一会儿说喜欢小狗，一会儿又说讨厌小狗，说话太自相矛盾了。
py: tā yī huì r shuō xǐ huan xiǎo gǒu yī huì r yòu shuō tǎo yàn xiǎo gǒu shuō huà tài zì xiāng máo dùn le
en: He says he likes dogs, then says he hates them; he contradicts himself.
why: Saying two things that cancel each other is 自相矛盾. 一模一样 would mean the two statements are identical, and the others do not describe talk.

q: 这条裙子本来就很漂亮，你再加一条腰带反而成了___。
zh: 这条裙子本来就很漂亮，你再加一条腰带反而成了画蛇添足。
py: zhè tiáo qún zi běn lái jiù hěn piào liang nǐ zài jiā yī tiáo yāo dài fǎn ér chéng le huà shé tiān zú
en: The skirt was pretty already; adding a belt only made it worse.
why: An unneeded addition that spoils something good is 画蛇添足. 一举两得 would mean the belt brought two gains, the opposite of 反而.

q: 我对着小猫讲了半天道理，它只管睡觉，我真是___。
zh: 我对着小猫讲了半天道理，它只管睡觉，我真是对牛弹琴。
py: wǒ duì zhe xiǎo māo jiǎng le bàn tiān dào lǐ tā zhǐ guǎn shuì jiào wǒ zhēn shì duì niú tán qín
en: I lectured the kitten for ages and it just kept sleeping; I was wasting my breath.
why: Talking to someone who does not take it in is 对牛弹琴. 亡羊补牢 is repairing after a loss and 一举两得 is a double gain.

q: 他每天只是刷手机，等着有人给他介绍工作，这样___，是找不到工作的。
zh: 他每天只是刷手机，等着有人给他介绍工作，这样守株待兔，是找不到工作的。
py: tā měi tiān zhǐ shì shuā shǒu jī děng zhe yǒu rén gěi tā jiè shào gōng zuò zhè yàng shǒu zhū dài tù shì zhǎo bù dào gōng zuò de
en: He just scrolls his phone all day waiting for someone to find him a job; sitting and waiting like that, he will not find work.
why: Waiting for luck to arrive is 守株待兔. 亡羊补牢 is about repairing, 一举两得 is a double gain, and 入乡随俗 is following local customs.

s: 考砸了以后，他才开始每天复习，这是守株待兔。
s_py: kǎo zá le yǐ hòu tā cái kāi shǐ měi tiān fù xí zhè shì shǒu zhū dài tù
zh: 考砸了以后，他才开始每天复习，这是亡羊补牢。
py: kǎo zá le yǐ hòu tā cái kāi shǐ měi tiān fù xí zhè shì wáng yáng bǔ láo
en: He only began reviewing every day after failing; better late than never.
why: Taking action after a failure is 亡羊补牢. 守株待兔 means sitting waiting for luck, the opposite of working.

s: 他说话前后自相矛盾，所以没有人相信他。
s_py: tā shuō huà qián hòu zì xiāng máo dùn suǒ yǐ méi yǒu rén xiāng xìn tā
zh: 他说话前后自相矛盾，所以没有人相信他。
py: tā shuō huà qián hòu zì xiāng máo dùn suǒ yǐ méi yǒu rén xiāng xìn tā
en: What he says contradicts itself, so nobody believes him.
why: Correct. 自相矛盾 works as a predicate after 前后, and contradicting oneself is a good reason not to be believed.

s: 他很井底之蛙，从来没出过远门。
s_py: tā hěn jǐng dǐ zhī wā cóng lái méi chū guò yuǎn mén
zh: 他就是一只井底之蛙，从来没出过远门。
py: tā jiù shì yī zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā cóng lái méi chū guò yuǎn mén
en: He is a real frog in a well; he has never travelled far.
why: 井底之蛙 is a noun (a frog), not an adjective, so 很 cannot precede it. Use 是 with a measure word such as 一只.

q: 你明天要坐飞机去上海了，祝你___！
zh: 你明天要坐飞机去上海了，祝你一路平安！
py: nǐ míng tiān yào zuò fēi jī qù shàng hǎi le zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
en: You are flying to Shanghai tomorrow; have a safe journey!
why: To someone about to travel, the wish is 一路平安. The other options are proverbs or a feeling, not wishes after 祝你.

q: 新的一年开始了，祝你身体健康，___！
zh: 新的一年开始了，祝你身体健康，万事如意！
py: xīn de yī nián kāi shǐ le zhù nǐ shēn tǐ jiàn kāng wàn shì rú yì
en: The new year has begun; I wish you good health and all the best!
why: A general wish for the new year is 万事如意. 一路平安 is only for someone travelling.

q: 我练了很多遍，现在打字越来越快了，真是___。
zh: 我练了很多遍，现在打字越来越快了，真是熟能生巧。
py: wǒ liàn le hěn duō biàn xiàn zài dǎ zì yuè lái yuè kuài le zhēn shì shú néng shēng qiǎo
en: I practised many times and now I type faster and faster; practice makes perfect.
why: Improvement through repetition is 熟能生巧. 百闻不如一见 is about seeing for yourself, and 入乡随俗 is about local customs.

q: 网上看了很多次，这次亲眼看到大熊猫才明白，真是___。
zh: 网上看了很多次，这次亲眼看到大熊猫才明白，真是百闻不如一见。
py: wǎng shàng kàn le hěn duō cì zhè cì qīn yǎn kàn dào dà xióng māo cái míng bai zhēn shì bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
en: I had looked at pandas online many times, but only seeing one in person made it clear: seeing is believing.
why: Hearing or reading many times is not as good as seeing once: 百闻不如一见, and 亲眼 points to it.

q: 骑自行车上班，又省钱又锻炼身体，真是___。
zh: 骑自行车上班，又省钱又锻炼身体，真是一举两得。
py: qí zì xíng chē shàng bān yòu shěng qián yòu duàn liàn shēn tǐ zhēn shì yī jǔ liǎng dé
en: Cycling to work saves money and gets you exercise; two birds with one stone.
why: One action with two gains is 一举两得. 画蛇添足 means an addition that spoils things, which does not match two benefits.

q: 在国外的餐厅要给小费，___，我们也给吧。
zh: 在国外的餐厅要给小费，入乡随俗，我们也给吧。
py: zài guó wài de cān tīng yào gěi xiǎo fèi rù xiāng suí sú wǒ men yě gěi ba
en: In restaurants abroad you tip; when in Rome, let us tip too.
why: Following local customs is 入乡随俗. The other options are a feeling, talking to oneself, or a travel wish.

s: 朋友在家生病了，我说祝你一路平安。
s_py: péng you zài jiā shēng bìng le wǒ shuō zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
zh: 朋友在家生病了，我说祝你早日康复。
py: péng you zài jiā shēng bìng le wǒ shuō zhù nǐ zǎo rì kāng fù
en: My friend was ill at home, and I said I hope you recover soon.
why: 一路平安 is only for someone setting off on a journey. A friend ill at home gets 祝你早日康复.

s: 你每天说几句汉语，熟能生巧，进步会很快。
s_py: nǐ měi tiān shuō jǐ jù hàn yǔ shú néng shēng qiǎo jìn bù huì hěn kuài
zh: 你每天说几句汉语，熟能生巧，进步会很快。
py: nǐ měi tiān shuō jǐ jù hàn yǔ shú néng shēng qiǎo jìn bù huì hěn kuài
en: Say a few sentences of Chinese every day; practice makes perfect and you will progress fast.
why: Correct. 熟能生巧 is a proverb said as a whole comment, with the advice before or after it.

q: 刚到一个新国家，要___，多了解当地的习惯。
zh: 刚到一个新国家，要入乡随俗，多了解当地的习惯。
py: gāng dào yī gè xīn guó jiā yào rù xiāng suí sú duō liǎo jiě dāng dì de xí guàn
en: When you have just arrived in a new country, follow local customs and learn about local habits.
why: Adapting to local habits in a new place is 入乡随俗. 熟能生巧 would be about practice, which the sentence does not mention.

q: 在小店买衣服可以___，老板会便宜一点儿。
zh: 在小店买衣服可以讨价还价，老板会便宜一点儿。
py: zài xiǎo diàn mǎi yī fu kě yǐ tǎo jià huán jià lǎo bǎn huì pián yi yī diǎn r
en: You can haggle when buying clothes at a small shop; the owner will take a little off.
why: Bargaining over the price is 讨价还价. The other idioms have nothing to do with price.

q: 鞋店里有___的鞋，样子和颜色都不一样。
zh: 鞋店里有各种各样的鞋，样子和颜色都不一样。
py: xié diàn lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de xié yàng zi hé yán sè dōu bù yī yàng
en: The shoe shop has all kinds of shoes, all different in style and colour.
why: "All kinds of" before 的 + noun is 各种各样. 一模一样 would mean identical, contradicting 都不一样.

q: 他一个人在房间里___，好像在背课文。
zh: 他一个人在房间里自言自语，好像在背课文。
py: tā yī gè rén zài fáng jiān lǐ zì yán zì yǔ hǎo xiàng zài bèi kè wén
en: He is alone in his room talking to himself, as if learning a text by heart.
why: Talking to oneself when alone is 自言自语. 讨价还价 needs another person to haggle with.

q: 老师刚问完问题，他没想就___，答案是三。
zh: 老师刚问完问题，他没想就脱口而出，答案是三。
py: lǎo shī gāng wèn wán wèn tí tā méi xiǎng jiù tuō kǒu ér chū dá àn shì sān
en: The teacher had just asked the question and, without thinking, he blurted out that the answer was three.
why: Saying something without thinking is 脱口而出. 一丝不苟 would mean he was careful, which 没想 contradicts.

q: 这两只小狗长得___，我分不清谁是谁。
zh: 这两只小狗长得一模一样，我分不清谁是谁。
py: zhè liǎng zhī xiǎo gǒu zhǎng de yī mú yī yàng wǒ fēn bù qīng shéi shì shéi
en: These two puppies look exactly alike; I cannot tell which is which.
why: Not telling them apart means they look identical: 长得一模一样. 各种各样 means many different kinds.

q: 我和她买了___的裙子，穿在一起像双胞胎。
zh: 我和她买了一模一样的裙子，穿在一起像双胞胎。
py: wǒ hé tā mǎi le yī mú yī yàng de qún zi chuān zài yī qǐ xiàng shuāng bāo tāi
en: She and I bought exactly the same skirt; together we look like twins.
why: Like twins means identical skirts: 一模一样 + 的 before the noun. The other options do not describe clothes.

q: 手机里有___的软件，有的用来学习，有的用来玩游戏。
zh: 手机里有各种各样的软件，有的用来学习，有的用来玩游戏。
py: shǒu jī lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de ruǎn jiàn yǒu de yòng lái xué xí yǒu de yòng lái wán yóu xì
en: The phone has all kinds of apps; some are for study and some for games.
why: 有的...有的 lists different kinds, so 各种各样的. 一模一样 would mean they are all the same.

q: 他想了一下，没有___，而是慢慢地回答了问题。
zh: 他想了一下，没有脱口而出，而是慢慢地回答了问题。
py: tā xiǎng le yī xià méi yǒu tuō kǒu ér chū ér shì màn màn de huí dá le wèn tí
en: He thought for a moment; he did not blurt it out but answered the question slowly.
why: 没有...而是 contrasts a considered answer with a thoughtless one: 脱口而出 is the thoughtless one. The other options do not describe how to answer.

q: 她___老板讨价还价了半天，最后才买下那台电脑。
zh: 她跟老板讨价还价了半天，最后才买下那台电脑。
py: tā gēn lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià le bàn tiān zuì hòu cái mǎi xià nà tái diàn nǎo
en: She haggled with the owner for ages before finally buying the computer.
why: 讨价还价 takes no object, so the other party is introduced with 跟. 把 and a bare object are wrong.

q: 她对着电脑屏幕小声___，好像在练习演讲。
zh: 她对着电脑屏幕小声自言自语，好像在练习演讲。
py: tā duì zhe diàn nǎo píng mù xiǎo shēng zì yán zì yǔ hǎo xiàng zài liàn xí yǎn jiǎng
en: She mumbled to herself at the computer screen, as if practising a speech.
why: Quietly speaking to oneself is 自言自语. The other options need another person or are not about speaking.

s: 她跟老板讨价还价了很久，终于便宜了二十块。
s_py: tā gēn lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú pián yi le èr shí kuài
zh: 她跟老板讨价还价了很久，终于便宜了二十块。
py: tā gēn lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú pián yi le èr shí kuài
en: She haggled with the owner for a long time and finally got twenty yuan off.
why: Correct. The person you haggle with comes before the idiom with 跟, and 了 follows the idiom with a duration.

s: 他对着镜子脱口而出，好像在和自己说话。
s_py: tā duì zhe jìng zi tuō kǒu ér chū hǎo xiàng zài hé zì jǐ shuō huà
zh: 他对着镜子自言自语，好像在和自己说话。
py: tā duì zhe jìng zi zì yán zì yǔ hǎo xiàng zài hé zì jǐ shuō huà
en: He talked to himself in the mirror, as if speaking to himself.
why: Talking to yourself is 自言自语. 脱口而出 means blurting out something without thinking and needs the words that were blurted.

q: 他___地改了几个字就交了，连题目都没看清楚。
zh: 他马马虎虎地改了几个字就交了，连题目都没看清楚。
py: tā mǎ mǎ hǔ hǔ de gǎi le jǐ ge zì jiù jiāo le lián tí mù dōu méi kàn qīng chu
en: He changed a few characters carelessly and handed it in without even reading the question properly.
why: Not even reading the question shows careless work: 马马虎虎地. 一丝不苟, 聚精会神 and 废寝忘食 all describe diligence, which 连...都没 contradicts.

q: 这两个手机壳___一模一样，我分不清哪个是我的。
zh: 这两个手机壳一模一样，我分不清哪个是我的。
py: zhè liǎng ge shǒu jī ké yī mú yī yàng wǒ fēn bù qīng nǎ ge shì wǒ de
en: These two phone cases are exactly alike; I cannot tell which is mine.
why: 一模一样 already means "exactly the same", so no degree word goes before it. 很, 非常 and 比较 would all be wrong.

q: 孩子们___兴高采烈地冲进了宠物店。
zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地冲进了宠物店。
py: hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de chōng jìn le chǒng wù diàn
en: The children rushed into the pet shop in high spirits.
why: 兴高采烈 is already extreme, so it is used bare with 地. 很, 非常 and 太 cannot precede it.

q: 我对那只小狗___一见钟情。
zh: 我对那只小狗一见钟情。
py: wǒ duì nà zhī xiǎo gǒu yī jiàn zhōng qíng
en: I fell for that puppy at first sight.
why: The thing you fall for is introduced by 对 before 一见钟情, which takes no object. 把, 给 and 让 would not fit after the idiom.

q: 他说无论如何___要把这个游戏通关。
zh: 他说无论如何都要把这个游戏通关。
py: tā shuō wú lùn rú hé dōu yào bǎ zhè ge yóu xì tōng guān
en: He said he would finish this game no matter what.
why: 无论如何 is followed by 都 before the verb phrase. 却, 才 and 又 do not pair with it.

q: 他从没出过城，真的___一只井底之蛙。
zh: 他从没出过城，真的是一只井底之蛙。
py: tā cóng méi chū guò chéng zhēn de shì yī zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā
en: He has never left the city; he really is a frog in a well.
why: 井底之蛙 is a noun, so the verb 是 and a measure word are needed. 很, 非常 and 最 cannot go before a noun idiom.

q: 我买了一部和他___的手机。
zh: 我买了一部和他一模一样的手机。
py: wǒ mǎi le yī bù hé tā yī mú yī yàng de shǒu jī
en: I bought a phone exactly like his.
why: 和他 compares two things, and 一模一样 + 的 before the noun means "identical". 各种各样 means many kinds and cannot compare with 和他.

q: 这两个游戏的画面___一模一样，只是名字不同。
zh: 这两个游戏的画面完全一模一样，只是名字不同。
py: zhè liǎng ge yóu xì de huà miàn wán quán yī mú yī yàng zhǐ shì míng zi bù tóng
en: The graphics of these two games are exactly the same; only the names differ.
why: 完全 strengthens 一模一样. 很, 特别 and 比较 are degree words and cannot go before an idiom that already means "exactly".

q: 他的话前后___，我不知道该相信哪一句。
zh: 他的话前后自相矛盾，我不知道该相信哪一句。
py: tā de huà qián hòu zì xiāng máo dùn wǒ bù zhī dào gāi xiāng xìn nǎ yī jù
en: His words contradict each other; I do not know which to believe.
why: Not knowing which statement to believe means he contradicts himself: 自相矛盾. The others describe feelings or attention.

q: 双胞胎姐妹穿着___的衣服，连颜色都一样。
zh: 双胞胎姐妹穿着一模一样的衣服，连颜色都一样。
py: shuāng bāo tāi jiě mèi chuān zhe yī mú yī yàng de yī fu lián yán sè dōu yī yàng
en: The twin sisters wore identical clothes, even the same colour.
why: Identical, even in colour, is 一模一样 + 的 before the noun. 各种各样 would mean many different kinds, which contradicts 颜色都一样.

s: 这个手机壳和那个很一模一样。
s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī ké hé nà ge hěn yī mú yī yàng
zh: 这个手机壳和那个一模一样。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī ké hé nà ge yī mú yī yàng
en: This phone case is exactly the same as that one.
why: 一模一样 already means "exactly the same", so 很 cannot be put before it.

s: 弟弟一见钟情了那只小猫。
s_py: dì di yī jiàn zhōng qíng le nà zhī xiǎo māo
zh: 弟弟对那只小猫一见钟情了。
py: dì di duì nà zhī xiǎo māo yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
en: My little brother fell for that kitten at first sight.
why: 一见钟情 cannot take an object. The one fallen for goes before it with 对.

s: 这两双运动鞋一模一样，价格却差很多。
s_py: zhè liǎng shuāng yùn dòng xié yī mú yī yàng jià gé què chā hěn duō
zh: 这两双运动鞋一模一样，价格却差很多。
py: zhè liǎng shuāng yùn dòng xié yī mú yī yàng jià gé què chā hěn duō
en: These two pairs of trainers are identical but the prices differ a lot.
why: Correct. 一模一样 is a predicate used bare; the contrast comes from 却, not from the idiom.

s: 这件事太不可思议了，我还以为是在做梦。
s_py: zhè jiàn shì tài bù kě sī yì le wǒ hái yǐ wéi shì zài zuò mèng
zh: 这件事太不可思议了，我还以为是在做梦。
py: zhè jiàn shì tài bù kě sī yì le wǒ hái yǐ wéi shì zài zuò mèng
en: This is so incredible I thought I was dreaming.
why: Correct. Judgement idioms like 不可思议 can take 太...了, even though descriptive idioms cannot take a degree word.
